summary: Pampa Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its Q2 2026 earnings release. The filing reports sales of US$746 million, a 53% year-on-year increase, adjusted EBITDA of US$415 million, and net income of US$172 million. Net debt rose to US$1.3 billion from US$801 million due to capital expenditures and oil hedging collateral. No special-situation corporate event is announced; the filing is a routine earnings report for the Argentine energy company.
